correctness.rationale: The exact 4x4 random state update gives two independently verified covariance blocks. At zero momentum the even and odd roots are L=(1+c²)/2 and (1-c²)/2. Implicit differentiation gives a(c)=-2c²(1-c²)/(1+c²)², and second differentiation b(0)=1. The orthogonal cubic at t=1/2 has strictly negative value, proving a root >1/2. Spectral separation, positivity of the initial-error functional, implicit-function theory and the compactness exclusion of remote momenta prove unique optimal M=c²+O(c⁴) and minimum L-c⁴+O(c⁶). Exactly 285 standalone verifier assertions passed; numerical checks are not treated as proofs.
